name: The Law of Revenge
description: Witness the lives of two opposing women, which triggers the great controversy between their two opposing families as they are entangled in a web of lies, mysteries, secrets, intrigues, betrayals, conspiracies, and shocking revelations.

videos.title: Marissa's Sacrifice
videos.overview: The close bond between best friends Ellice and Marissa changes forever after one fateful night.

videos.title: The Repercussions of a Lie
videos.overview: To secure her mother and her friend's respective futures, Marissa takes the blame for Victor's untimely demise.

videos.title: Concealing Truths
videos.overview: As her guilt over Victor's death takes a toll on her mental health, Ellice crosses paths with Gabriel in the US. Marissa suffers from different forms of torment in prison.

videos.title: Marissa in the Flesh
videos.overview: Ellice refuses to give up her father's company despite being on the brink of bankruptcy. Marissa surprises her best friend with her return.

videos.title: The Payback
videos.overview: Marissa sets her revenge plan against Ellice into motion. Ellice takes control of her company's problem amid her delicate pregnancy.

videos.title: The Offer
videos.overview: Ellice is devastated when she suffers another miscarriage. Marissa offers to help her best friend secure a deal with a client for Ceñidoza Pearls.

videos.title: The Manipulation
videos.overview: Marissa uses Ellice and Gabriel's marital problems to manipulate her best friend.

videos.title: The Seduction
videos.overview: After keeping Ellice from making amends with her husband, Marissa lures Gabriel to her home to seduce him.

videos.title: The Conception
videos.overview: Ellice and Gabriel are met with disappointment when they learn the news about their anonymous surrogate.

videos.title: The Announcement
videos.overview: Marissa's evil scheme gets foiled by Ellice and Gabriel's unexpected announcement at the Pearls by Ceñidoza's relaunch party.

videos.title: The Co-habitation
videos.overview: Filled with concern over her best friend's pregnancy, Ellice invites Marissa to move in to her and Gabriel's home.

videos.title: The Childbirth
videos.overview: Gabriel shows kindness toward Marissa and her unborn child as guilt slowly eats him up.

videos.title: The Competition
videos.overview: Gabriel arouses everyone's suspicion as he shuffles back and forth to support Marissa and Ellice during their respective deliveries.

videos.title: The Struggle
videos.overview: After Ellice convinced her husband to return to work, Marissa comes up with a plan to get closer to Gabriel.

videos.title: The Challenges
videos.overview: Ellice tries to keep her composure as a mishap puts her daughter in critical condition. Marissa convinces Gabriel to help her take care of her son in the office.

videos.title: The Impossible Feat
videos.overview: While the tension between Ellice and Sonya escalates, Marissa takes advantage of Gabriel's fondness for Jacob.

videos.title: The Envy
videos.overview: Determined to save her daughter's life, Ellice begs Dr. Calleja to attend to Hope's critical condition. Lucing rebukes Marissa for fawning over Gabriel.

videos.title: The Suspicion
videos.overview: Piecing her daughter's past actions, Lucing begins to doubt Marissa's intentions.

videos.title: The Crisis
videos.overview: Envy engulfs Ellice as Marissa gets close with Gabriel's family. Ramon sees through the secret about Jacob's parentage.

videos.title: The Golden Boy
videos.overview: Ellice's relationships with Gabriel and Marissa take a huge hit as Ceñidoza Pearls plunges into an unexpected financial difficulty.

videos.title: Bringing Up the Past
videos.overview: Ellice grows suspicious of her best friend's close relationship with her husband. Marissa reveals to Gabriel the truth about Jacob's father.

videos.title: The Onset of Revenge
videos.overview: When a realization dawns on her, Ellice takes back the accusations she made against Marissa and gives her best friend a tempting offer.

videos.title: The Sexual Tension
videos.overview: An unfortunate accident forces Marissa and Gabriel to pull an all-nighter at the office.

videos.title: The Organization
videos.overview: Gabriel and Marissa are overjoyed after securing an important business deal for Ceñidoza Pearls. Marissa receives an urgent call from an acquaintance.

videos.title: The Enemy Within
videos.overview: As Marissa begins to quietly take over Ellice's spot among the Villarosas and Ceñidoza Pearls, she faces a sudden complication when an unlikely individual shows up at the company.

videos.title: The Benefit of the Doubt
videos.overview: Ellice finds herself slowly being consumed by doubt over Marissa and Gabriel's closeness. Unsatisfied with his partner's progress, Caesar begins putting his own plan into action.

videos.title: The Assurance
videos.overview: After failing to reach Gabriel, Marissa receives help from an unlikely ally as she races against time to save Jacob from his condition.

videos.title: The Decoy
videos.overview: Ramon confronts Gabriel about Jacob's parentage. A new Ceñidoza Pearls employee poses a threat to Marissa's plans of stealing Gabriel from Ellice.

videos.title: The Seeds of Doubt
videos.overview: Ellice turns livid when she learns of Andres' alleged crime. Marissa manipulates her best friend into believing that Gabriel is having an affair with Meredith.

videos.title: The Paranoia
videos.overview: Ellice ends up confronting Meredith when her doubts against the other woman reaches boiling point.

videos.title: The Ex-girlfriend
videos.overview: Tension brews as Ellice plans a night out with her two cunning best friends, Marissa and Agatha.

videos.title: The Rivalry of Traitors
videos.overview: Growing suspicious of Marissa, Agatha hires a private investigator to dig up dirt on the Ceñidoza Pearls COO.

videos.title: The Calm Before the Storm
videos.overview: Ellice blows a fuse when she receives a picture of Agatha and Gabriel sharing an intimate moment at a restaurant.

videos.title: The Acknowledgement of Paternity
videos.overview: Ellice's world is shattered into pieces when she finally finds out the heartbreaking secret between Marissa and Gabriel.

videos.title: The Investigation
videos.overview: Ellice plans to seek revenge against Marissa and Gabriel after finally learning the truth about Jacob.

videos.title: The Taunting
videos.overview: Ellice tries to gather evidence on Marissa and Gabriel's affair. Carmelita confronts her son for cheating on his wife.

videos.title: The Retaliation
videos.overview: Marissa discovers that Ellice is spying on her. Lucing figures out the truth about Jacob's father.

videos.title: The Conflict
videos.overview: Tension rises between Marissa and Ellice as they vie for Gabriel's attention following the Ceñidoza Pearls CEO's return to work.

videos.title: The Witness
videos.overview: Marissa turns pale when she encounters a familiar face in Ceñidoza Pearls. Ellice is out for blood as she resolves to find dirt on her best friend to force her out of the company.

videos.title: The Unexpected Ally
videos.overview: Ellice discovers shocking information against her best friend turned enemy. Marissa receives a harsh slap of reality.

videos.title: The Impending Danger
videos.overview: Ellice finds herself in grave danger as she investigates her suspicions about Marissa.

videos.title: The Rescue
videos.overview: Filled with guilt over his wife's state, Gabriel plans to tell Ellice the truth about his relationship with Marissa.

videos.title: The Determined Wife
videos.overview: Ellice finally gets her hands on a strong proof of Gabriel and Marissa's past affair.

videos.title: The Turn of Events
videos.overview: Ellice makes her return to Ceñidoza Pearls prepared to expose Marissa's involvement in the company's financial troubles.

videos.title: The Truth Unrevealed
videos.overview: Ellice's heart breaks into a million pieces as she comes face-to-face with a series of harrowing betrayals.

videos.title: The Mind Games
videos.overview: Marissa plans to gain the Villarosas' sympathy after telling Sonya about Ellice's allegations against her.

videos.title: One Upmanship
videos.overview: Determined to put Marissa in her place, Ellice rejects the Ceñidoza Pearls COO's proposal in front of their company's board of directors.

videos.title: The Termination
videos.overview: Tension brews inside the Ceñidoza Pearls' conference room as Ellice and Marissa vie for an important client's approval.

videos.title: The Termination
videos.overview: The rivalry between Marissa and Ellice reaches boiling point on the night of Mr. Madriaga's show.

videos.title: The Broken Pieces
videos.overview: Marissa falls into disgrace when Ellice exposes her dirty secrets in front of the Ceñidoza Pearls employees.

videos.title: The Persistence
videos.overview: Despite being fired from Ceñidoza Pearls, Marissa is determined to return to Ellice's company and continue her revenge plan against her old friend.

videos.title: The Unknown Heir
videos.overview: The Villarosas are devastated when a beloved family member passes away. Ellice and Marissa cause a scene at the wake of Gabriel's loved one.

videos.title: The Threat
videos.overview: After knowing the contents of Ramon's last will and testament, Ellice reaches her breaking point upon learning another secret that Gabriel kept from her.

videos.title: The End of Revenge
videos.overview: Ellice's confidence begins to crumble when a crisis at Ceñidoza Pearls leads to a familiar face making a return to the company.

videos.title: The Blast from the Past
videos.overview: Ellice finds a beacon of hope amid her darkest days upon the return of an old friend.

videos.title: The Indecent Proposal
videos.overview: After venting out her frustrations to her old friend, Ellice immediately regrets letting her guard down when she learns of Francis' hidden agenda.

videos.title: The Cover-up
videos.overview: Francis proposes a deal with Ellice in exchange for keeping his silence over her long-kept secret.

videos.title: The Truth Revealed
videos.overview: Gabriel finally learns about Ellice and Marissa's long-kept secret.

videos.title: The End and the Beginning
videos.overview: Ellice faces the bitter consequences of her actions when the truth of her crime comes to light. Gabriel finally accepts the true feelings that he has for Marissa.

videos.title: The Divorce and the Proposal
videos.overview: Coming to terms with his true feelings for Marissa, Gabriel tells Ellice that he wants a divorce.

videos.title: The Scorned Wife
videos.overview: Filled with rage over Marissa and Gabriel's affair, Ellice accepts Caesar's tempting offer. Adelina reveals her past to Marissa in hopes of convincing her to be her successor.

videos.title: The Escape from Death
videos.overview: Getting wind of the hit put out on her, Marissa rushes herself to safety. In her ensuing escape, two lives are tragically cut short.

videos.title: The Revelation of La Sierra's Owner
The Truth According to the Deceased
